title: PU-12M lesson 2: the radiotelephone operator
status: A seat lesson (docs/TUTORIALS.md): step by step, each control highlighted, the next step only once it is done.
source: sam3d; the moves, their order and their waits are the console's procedures (data/procedures/pu12m.json: headset_on_radio_operator, deploy_mast, tune_r111, r111_spare, fug4_spare) and the crew data's reports and orders (data/crew/pu12m_crew.json), with their sources; the R-111's order of work from its ТО (r111_to pp. 64-67); the air picture read out to the plotter (pvo_bu_x_1984 art. 23); the change of frequency and jamming (rrs_1986, pvo_bu_ix_1984; docs/crew/12_COMMUNICATIONS.md)
notes: The battery commander's first order is given by the lesson (on_start) at the learner's pace; the later ones are the NPC commander's own (he hears the regiment on his RTK-1's second receiver and the battery net on its talk channel). The lesson's scenario starts with the headset off and the RK-1U on ВЫКЛ and С-23, so the learner sets them.

steps.title: The radiotelephone operator's seat
lines: You are the radiotelephone operator (No. 3): on the bench at the left.

You keep the post in touch: the R-123M FuG-4 on the battery net to the launchers, the R-111 FuG-3 on the regiment's command net, the RK-1U that takes the regiment's telecode to the ASPD-U, the mast that lifts the aerials and the power board that feeds the equipment. And you are the post's ear on the air-picture net: what the radar company reports, you read out to the plotter.
Each step lights up what to use; only that works. Read, then press Enter.
steps.hint: Enter: next.   Mouse: look round.   L: turn your head to what is highlighted.

steps.title: Your headset (шлемофон)
lines: First your шлемофон: put it on and plug its cord into your box, the PVS-1.
Without it you hear only voices in the cabin: no intercom, no radio. With it you hear what your box is switched to.
steps.why: The post has no loudspeaker: every radio and the intercom are heard in the headsets (the NVA's signals schematic).
steps.hint: J: put it on (or point the cross at it, left click).

steps.title: The PVS-1 box
lines: The PVS-1 is your box. Its selector puts your headset on the intercom (ВС) or on one of the post's four R-123M/R-111 sets (РСТ-1 to РСТ-4); on a set you still hear the intercom. Its button calls the commander's RTK-1.
РСТ-1 is the FuG-1, the air-picture net: that is where you will sit.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   K: turn your box.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The R-111 (FuG-3)
lines: In front of you: the R-111, the regiment's command net. Its РЕЖ. РАБОТЫ switch (left of the two wing knobs in the black oval), the ИНДИКАТОР and its meter, the preset buttons (ЗПЧ, the column right of centre) and the big УСТАНОВКА ЧАСТОТЫ knob, lower right.
It reaches 35 km whip to whip, 45 with one end on a mast, 60 with both (its ТО).
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The R-123M (FuG-4)
lines: Above it, an R-123M: the battery net, to the launchers. The commander talks on it through his RTK-1; you set it up and keep it on frequency.
Its ФИКСИР. ЧАСТОТЫ switch holds four frequencies set up in the park from the radio data: 1 the net's working frequency, 2 its spare.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The RK-1U junction box
lines: Beside it: the RK-1U. It routes the ASPD-U's telecode: ПРИЕМ says where its receiver takes it from (the R-407, or a wire line), the code switch which equipment it feeds (the ASPD-U, or the S-23).
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The radio data
lines: On your table: the radio data (радиоданные). Each net, its frequencies by number, the main station and the call signs: the post is Рябина to the regiment (Тополь), the radar company (Ромашка) and the covered regiment (Клён); on its own battery net it is 10, the launchers 21 and 22.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The ŠČR distribution board
lines: On the wall at your left: the ŠČR board, which switches the 220 V to the equipment, and the VS-27 rectifier that keeps the batteries charged.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The mast's winch
lines: Across the post: the winch of the telescopic mast, 16 m up when raised and guyed.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The commander: «Пункт управления развернуть!»
lines: The battery commander orders the post deployed (you hear it on the intercom). Your part: the radios, the mast, the power to the equipment, the telecode's path and your box.
steps.hint: Enter: next.   Mouse: look round.   L: turn your head to what is highlighted.

steps.title: The R-123M on: ПИТАНИЕ
lines: Switch the R-123M (FuG-4) on: ПИТАНИЕ. Its other switch is on СИМПЛЕКС already: the battery net is worked both ways.
steps.why: A radio's valves take a while to warm: on first, used later.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: The R-111 on duty reception
lines: R-111: РЕЖ. РАБОТЫ to ДЕЖ. ПР. (duty reception). The set listens; its scale settles to within 6 kHz in five minutes.
steps.why: Duty reception draws 2 A, the least of any mode: the set warms while you raise the mast.
steps.hint: Point the cross at the left wing knob; left click turns it one position on.

steps.title: Raise the mast
lines: Raise the mast: get up and work the winch (it is beyond your seat; L takes you there).
steps.why: Up 16 m the aerials see over the trees and the folds of the ground: the regiment's net reaches the post.
steps.hint: L: step to it.   Left click.

steps.title: 220 V to the equipment: ŠČR on
lines: When the driver has the AB-1 on line, switch the 220 V through to the equipment on the ŠČR board.
steps.why: The board waits for the driver's power: switched on before, it would switch nothing.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: The VS-27 rectifier on
lines: Switch the VS-27 on: it charges the batteries from the 220 V.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: RK-1U: ПРИЕМ to Р-407
lines: The RK-1U's ПРИЕМ to Р-407: the ASPD-U's receiver takes the regiment's telecode from the commander's R-407.
steps.why: On any other position the ASPD-U hears nothing from the regiment, however well the R-407 is tuned. When the telecode comes by wire instead, ПРОВОД.
steps.hint: Left click: one position on (three clicks).

steps.title: RK-1U: the code to the ASPD-U
lines: And the code switch to АСПД-У.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: Your box on the air-picture net: РСТ-1
lines: Your PVS-1 to РСТ-1: your headset on the FuG-1, the air-picture net. The radar company's reports will come in on it, and you still hear the intercom.
steps.why: The plotter has no box (he hears the cabin): the reports reach his board only through you.
steps.hint: K: turn your box (or left click on it).

steps.title: Report it: «Мачта поднята!»
lines: Tell the commander: Caps Lock, then «Мачта поднята!» (Mast up!).
steps.hint: Caps Lock: your reports; 0 says the green line (or its sector, then its number).

steps.chapter: The R-111 on the regiment's net
steps.title: Tune the R-111
lines: Now the R-111 onto the regiment's command net and tuned to transmit: the supply checked, telephony, 20 % power, the preset, and the automatic tuning.
steps.hint: Enter: next.

steps.title: ИНДИКАТОР to БОРТ. СЕТЬ
lines: Turn the ИНДИКАТОР (the right wing knob) to БОРТ. СЕТЬ: the meter shows the vehicle's 26 V, the needle in its sector.
steps.why: Above 30 V the set switches itself off; the ТО has the supply checked first.
steps.hint: Left click: one position on; right click: back.

steps.title: ВИД РАБОТЫ to ТЛФ
lines: ВИД РАБОТЫ (the wing knob in the black ring) to ТЛФ: telephony on the net.
steps.hint: Left click: one position on.

steps.title: РЕЖ. РАБОТЫ to МОЩНОСТЬ 20 %
lines: РЕЖ. РАБОТЫ to МОЩНОСТЬ 20 %.
steps.why: The output valves' cathodes now warm: 1.5-3 minutes before the transmitter may be tuned (r111_to). The least power that reaches the net: the less the enemy hears.
steps.hint: Left click: one position on.

steps.title: ЗПЧ 1: the regiment's net
lines: Press ЗПЧ 1. The mechanism turns the set to the first prepared frequency, the regiment's command net; its number shows in the НОМЕР ЗПЧ window.
steps.why: Four frequencies are prepared in the park (4 min); a press goes to one in seconds, standing or on the move.
steps.hint: Point the cross at the button, left click.

steps.title: ИНДИКАТОР to НАСТР. БУМ
lines: ИНДИКАТОР to НАСТР. БУМ: the meter will show the amplifier tuning.
steps.hint: Right click: one position back.

steps.title: НАСТРОЙКА УМ
steps.wait_text: the cathodes warm (3 min at 20 %) and the antenna on the mast
lines: When the cathodes are warm and the commander has put the R-111's antenna on the mast (the SAU block is at his place), press УМ. The НАСТРОЙКА lamp lights while the amplifier, then the antenna tuner, tune themselves; at most 45 s.
steps.why: Tuned, the set gives its power to the antenna: untuned, it cannot transmit.
steps.hint: Point the cross at the УМ button, left click.

steps.title: ИНДИКАТОР to ПР. УР.
steps.wait_text: the R-111 tuned: the НАСТРОЙКА lamp out
lines: When the НАСТРОЙКА lamp has gone out: ИНДИКАТОР to ПР. УР., the net's level.
steps.hint: Right click: back to ПР. УР.

steps.title: Report it: «Р-111 настроена!»
lines: Caps Lock, then «Р-111 настроена!» (R-111 tuned!).
steps.hint: Caps Lock: your reports; 0 says the green line (or its sector, then its number).

steps.title: Report it: «Связь с КП полка есть!»
lines: When the net hears you and you hear it: Caps Lock, then «Связь с КП полка есть!» (In touch with the regiment!).
steps.hint: Caps Lock: your reports; 0 says the green line (or its sector, then its number).

steps.title: Who hears the regiment
lines: On the R-111 the regiment's command post talks to the battery: its orders come as three-digit groups of the talk table ПТ-1 (in violet on the screen), and as two digits on the IT-45 by telecode on the commander's R-407.

The commander hears the R-111 on his RTK-1's second receiver; your headset is on the air-picture net. Keep the set tuned and on the mast: without it, and with the telecode down, the battery hears nothing from the regiment.
steps.hint: Enter: next.

steps.title: The crew deploys
lines: Your part is done. The squad leader orients the post, the commander turns on the ASPD-U and his radios.

steps.title: The radar company reports
lines: A target is coming. The radar company (Ромашка) reports it on the air-picture net: in your headset, amber on the screen.

Each report is a target's number, its square on the coded map, its height and course. The plotter hears it too, on his headset on your box, and writes it on the board. You write every message your radios bring into the journal open on your table: the time, the net, who, what. It is the post's only record: what is missed is found again only on that page.
steps.hint: Enter: next.

steps.title: Take it down in the journal
steps.wait_text: a report on the air-picture net
lines: A report has come in: you heard it in your headset. Click the journal open on your table: the page comes up before your eyes, the report's words printed on its line, a box for each group of digits.

Type the digits as you heard them: a full box moves you to the next (Tab too). Backspace rubs out, Enter writes the line, S writes the short form (the number and the time only, when the net is too fast). Esc puts the page down.
What you write is what the page says: the plotter goes by it when he missed the report. One you don't write within half a minute is gone from your head.
steps.why: pvo_bu_x_1984 art. 24: the radiotelephonist writes every radiogram, signal, report and designation with the time he took it. When the plotter's box is off FuG-1, or he loses a report, the page is where he finds it, or where you read it to him from.
steps.hint: Point the cross at the pencil on the journal, left click.

steps.title: The regiment changes frequency
lines: The regiment's post (Тополь) orders its net to the spare frequency: a circular command, said twice, the ПТ-1 group 620. The commander hears it on his second receiver and tells you.

steps.title: ЗПЧ 2: the spare frequency
lines: «Р-111 — на запасную, ЗПЧ два!» Press ЗПЧ 2: the mechanism turns the set to the net's spare frequency in seconds.
steps.why: The order is said once, on the old frequency, with no receipt asked (rrs_1986): a station that misses it is off the net until it tries both frequencies, five minutes later.
steps.hint: Point the cross at the button, left click.

steps.title: Noise on the battery net
lines: A jammer comes on the battery net. The commander hears it in his headset: a rushing noise over every voice. He recognises it, logs it, and takes the net to its spare frequency: on air to the launchers, and to you for the post's own set.

steps.title: FuG-4 to ФИКСИР. ЧАСТОТЫ 2
lines: «Батарейную — на запасную!» Turn the FuG-4's ФИКСИР. ЧАСТОТЫ switch to 2: the battery net's spare frequency.
steps.why: A preset change takes seconds: the launchers are already there (each Osa's second set watches the spare), and the commander calls each one to check it hears him.
steps.hint: Left click: one position on.

steps.title: The radiotelephone operator's part: done
lines: That is your part: your headset on, the radios on, the mast up, the power through to the equipment, the telecode's path set, the R-111 on the regiment's net and tuned, every message written in the journal, and the post's sets kept on frequency when the net moves or is jammed.
Esc, then M: the missions menu, and the next seat's lesson.
